high_level_description: This image captures a young person standing on an airport tarmac, with a large airplane prominently featured in the background. The individual is dressed casually in a white t-shirt, beige sweatpants with the words "STAY COOL" printed on the right leg, and white sneakers. They have headphones around their neck and are wearing a backpack. The person appears to be looking off into the distance, possibly towards the airplane or something beyond it. The setting is clearly an airport, as indicated by the presence of the airplane, the tarmac, and the yellow safety markings on the ground.
